message.content: As part of the Unity Catalog migration, Impetus and Databricks requested that we extend account-level admin privileges to their team, a request we initially honored. We have since reversed that decision. Following yesterday's incident and conversations with both teams, we removed the admin access in place, a corrective step guided by our metricism framework to prevent similar issues from recurring in the future. To reduce disruption, we now provide an isolated workspace for Impetus to work within, so as not to disturb the active TLP workspaces running day-to-day. TLP's normal data pipeline operation remains the highest priority throughout this Unity Catalog engagement, and we will stay vigilant to ensure that.
